title: Card manifest
description: What a policy, delivery or authority card needs and offers, read by the template registry and the webapp. Every card folder holds one as card.json.

kind.description: A policy decides, a delivery module describes the policy decision naming the guardian operation, an authority issues a credential.

id.description: Stable identifier, such as the DUO term.

code.description: Short label shown beside the name.

rule.description: The rule in one line, as the owner reads it.

guardianTypes.description: The guardians a policy or delivery module can be attached to.

template.description: A rule template under policy_cards/templates/ whose policy.rego this card runs. Without it the card's own policy.rego runs.

facts.description: The credential types the module requires, per role. Must equal the module's requirements rule.

parameters.description: JSON Schema of the policy data the module reads; it generates the parameter form.

defaults.description: Parameter values the form starts from.

operation.description: The guardian operation a delivery module's decision names.

issues.description: The credential type an authority issues.

presenters.description: Who presents an authority's inputs, and where its output lands.
